title: path-fingerprint explainability for region/tier selection and fallback variant visibility
creator: Liam Chen
description: Problem: Engineers and SREs currently lack a compact, queryable representation of why a request was routed to a particular region/tier or why a fallback model variant was used. Existing telemetry emits per-hop spans and verbose provenance, but teams struggle to answer product questions (Which customers saw region fallbacks last 24h?), and on-call incidents require heavy trace reconstruction. Goal: Produce a lightweight, privacy-conscious 'path fingerprint' envelope for each routed request that encodes selection signals (region preference, tier constraints, policy weights), chosen fallback variant metadata, and a short justify-text snippet (derived from routing rules) plus links to more detailed spans when sampled. Deliverables: 1) spec for path-fingerprint JSON envelope and tl;dr schema; 2) runtime hook to emit envelope to telemetry pipeline for every decision with adaptive sampling; 3) dashboard and logs query templates to answer common queries (region fallback rates, tier mismatch ratios, variant-level error spikes); 4) migration plan to roll out incremental sampling and opt-outs for PII-sensitive tenants. This ticket covers spec, runtime prototype, and CI tests. Implementation will collaborate with telemetry infra and privacy/security teams.
acceptance_criteria: Define path-fingerprint schema (<= 1KB when serialized) that includes: deterministic path_id, route_keys (region, tier, policy_id), fallback_variant (if any), decision_reason_short (<= 128 chars), sampling_flag, and backref to sampled trace_id when available.
Runtime emits path-fingerprint for 100% of requests to internal topic 'routing.path_fingerprint' with adaptive downstream samplers; default capture retention is 7 days.
Add queryable views in observability (Grafana/ClickHouse) to report region fallback rate, tier-preference violations, and variant swap frequency grouped by customer and model family.
Privacy: offer tenant-level opt-out; no raw prompt/response content included in envelope; comply with KMS-protected PII handling in design doc.
E2E test that simulates tier outages and verifies fallback_variant is recorded and backref trace exists for sampled cases.
Document rollout plan and include a migration flag so we can toggle full vs sampled emission without redeploying routing logic.
tasks: Write spec doc: Confluence page + example payloads (link in attachments)
Add path-fingerprint marshal/unmarshal in routing-service (Go) with feature flag
Implement adaptive sampling controller (configurable by project/cycle) in telemetry-ingest
Produce Grafana dashboards and ClickHouse query templates for SLIs
Privacy sign-off: security review and tenant opt-out flows
Load test to validate overhead under high qps (target < 0.5% p99 additional latency)
comments: 2026-03-01 - Liam Chen: Kickoff meeting notes posted to Confluence. Agreed on compact envelope to reduce cardinallity pressure in ClickHouse. Aisha to prototype Go marshal in routing-service behind feature flag.

2026-03-02 - Aisha Kaur: Prototype implemented. Sample payload attached to Confluence. Observations: naive UUID path_id increases indexing cost; switched to 64-bit hash(seed=tenant+route) to reduce cardinality while retaining determinism.

2026-03-03 - Priya Nair (Telemetry): We've scoped an adaptive sampler in telemetry-ingest that uses tenant and model_family weight. Default sampling is 0.1% for production, 100% in staging. Need schema change review for downstream parsers.

2026-03-04 - Security Review - Marcus Hale: Concern about 'decision_reason_short' free-text leaking prompt info. Recommendation: only include canonical rule IDs and a templated natural-language string generator at query time. Marking security_review_required = true.

2026-03-06 - Aisha Kaur: Updated spec to remove any user content; replaced free-text with rule_id and a short canonical phrase from an allowlist. Added tenant opt-out flag to envelope when tenant disables path collection.

2026-03-07 - QA - Elena Rodriguez: Load test plan scheduled. Initial microbenchmarks show 0.12% median latency increase and p99 up by 0.4ms when emitting envelope synchronously. Proposal: emit to local async buffer and publish to topic to reduce tail impact.

2026-03-08 - DevOps - Kenji Park: Can we reuse existing routing topic or create 'routing.path_fingerprint' dedicated topic? Prefers dedicated topic to allow retention policies tuned for privacy and cost. Creating new topic approved.

2026-03-09 - Product - Maya Ortiz: This will unlock PM queries like 'which regions are causing fallbacks for EU customers' quickly. Request: include a boolean 'capacity_constrained' flag when fallback was due to capacity vs policy. Added as follow-up field.

2026-03-10 - Aisha Kaur: Feature branch opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infer-runtime/pull/9876. Tests added for schema validation, sampling behavior, and opt-out. Next: telemetry-ingest PR and dashboard templates. Moving to In Progress.
Follow-ups: schedule cross-team rollout for 2-week canary using 10% of traffic and backfill 7-day sample for historical analysis.
